year_display.zh: 元末至明中叶成书；现存最早完整刊本 1589 年

review.en: One hundred and eight outlaws gather, one story at a time, in the marshes of Liangshan under the Song. The early chapters, each centred on a single hero driven outside the law, are some of the most vivid storytelling in Chinese vernacular prose. Its violence is real and unsoftened; its sense of brotherhood and injustice has never stopped speaking to readers.
review.zh: 北宋末年，一百单八条好汉一个接一个被逼上梁山。前半部以人物为单元，武松、林冲、鲁智深各占几回，是白话小说里最鲜活的叙事。书里的暴力写得直接，不加粉饰；对不公的愤慨和对兄弟义气的看重，至今仍打动读者。作者旧题施耐庵，成书经过仍有争议。
